description: This file defines a concurrency utility and testing helper for managing isolated environment states in tests. It includes an actor-based lock for synchronization, and functions to temporarily set environment variables and UserDefaults during async test executions, ensuring state is restored afterward.

classes.name: TestIsolationLock
classes.description: An actor managing a lock mechanism to serialize access to test environment modifications.

methods.name: withIsolatedState
methods.description: Executes a given async closure within a temporarily modified environment and UserDefaults state, restoring original states after execution.

methods.name: withEnvValues
methods.description: Convenience method to run code with specified environment variables set temporarily.

methods.name: withUserDefaultsValues
methods.description: Convenience method to run code with specified UserDefaults values set temporarily.

methods.name: tempConfigPath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path for test configuration, not isolating environment but providing a utility.
